scores.evidence: Each of the 3 can-do objectives has 2 or more graded questions, and each has one at apply level or higher (o1: q4 apply, e1 analyze, e2 apply; o2: q2, q3, e3 evaluate; o3: q5, e6 apply). One gap remains: o1 lists 「CLAUDE.md・.claude/rules/・CLAUDE.local.md・権限ルール」, but its exam items test a hook (e2, answer 「フックで自動的に実行させる」) and when AGENTS.md is read (e1). Only q4 tests a choice among the places o1 names.

hook-b1 sets a concrete scenario in 3 sentences: the repeated test-command explanation and the senior's 300-line CLAUDE.md with 「`.env` は絶対に読まない」. Its promise now matches the prediction (「まず、`.env` の読み取りをどう止めるか、予想してみましょう」). q0 is an ungraded predict item tied to o3, and its explanation points ahead to 6-4.

The changed glossary entry セッション（session） now reads 「`claude` を起動すると始まる、ひと続きの会話。始めるたびに、まっさらなコンテキストから始まります。」. Its first clause matches cc-01 and cc-05 word for word, and it agrees with s1-lead (「第1回と第5回で見たとおり、セッションは毎回まっさらな状態で始まります」) and with the e6 option a feedback. Prerequisites and the recall of earlier lessons are unchanged (「第2回で書いた、ツールの使用を…」 in s4-defs), as is the definition of terms before use with English on first use.

measure.mjs gives 「prose 2399 (budget 1,200–2,400) · questions 9 · est 19.3 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)」, unchanged by the glossary edit. lint --strict reports 0 warnings. s3 still packs 3 new terms, a code block, a diagram, a callout and a check into one segment. 自動メモリ（auto memory） is defined in s1-defs, but no later block or question uses it.

s5-steps is a complete worked example placed before practice. It has 6 subgoal-labelled steps (「① コードからわかる行を消す」…「⑥ 自分だけの好みをローカルへ移す」), each with a reason in md and a result in expect (「チームのCLAUDE.mdは2行になります」). There is no faded example between it and the independent 19-line practice.

s1–s4 each end with an inline check, and every wrong option has feedback. q2 asks the learner to repair a conflict, q3 to judge which line can go, and q4 to place a 10-line rule set. q5 is still answerable by recognition: its answer 「CLAUDE.mdは判断の材料として読まれ、強制はされないから」 restates s4-lead 「参考に判断しますが、必ず守るという保証はありません」, which the learner has just read.

Every misconception in the brief appears as a distractor, with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer: override vs concatenation (q2 b, e1 a), `@` reducing context (q4 c, e3 a), long is better or the 200-line limit as a guarantee (q5 b, e6 b), 「覚えている」 (e6 a), and auto mode (e6 d). The 「IMPORTANT」 option is still a wrong answer in 5 of the 9 items (q0 a, q2 a, q5 a, e2 a, e3 c), and in both exam items where it appears, so a learner can eliminate it by pattern.

s3-diagram is exemplary: 5 nodes, labels in the text's own terms, and a caption that states the takeaway (「減らせるのは paths: 付きのルールです」). The changed s1-table, however, has labels that clash with its caption 「（広い順）」. 「どこでも」 comes after 「組織全体」 but sounds broader, and 「ここだけ」 vs 「チーム」 mixes where with who, so column 1 alone does not show the order.

The task is authentic and asks for near transfer: a 19-line file, with 「整形→フック候補」 and the combined test lines as new cases. It has a 3-level hint ladder (pr-decide hint, troubleshoot, practice-hint3), a 7-item checklist and a model answer. hint3 now matches the answer (「「ちゃんと」の行は…に直し、残りのテスト2行は1つにまとめます」), and practice-answer's highlight 6–12 covers exactly the 4 kept items and the comment that practice-answer-why describes.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next asks a reflection question (「ここ1週間で、Claudeに2回以上した同じ説明や直しはありますか」) and names the next lesson by its title. summary-cards has 7 cards, and summary-ask offers 3 tutor prompts.

The new セッション definition 「`claude` を起動すると始まる、ひと続きの会話」 matches cc-01-first-session and cc-05-context. It replaces 「1回分のやりとり」, which contradicted s1-lead's 「前の会話は引き継がれない」 framing of a session as a whole conversation. The audit-cc-06-claude-md.json findings stay fixed in the unchanged blocks (default qualifier in s3-defs and the AGENTS.md glossary entry, 「`git -C . push`」 in s4-close per cross-lesson-facts.md items 3–4, 「Claude Code v2.1.304」 pinned).

Learner text keeps です・ます and a warm tone (「まず…予想してみましょう」, 「迷ったら…確かめましょう」). The plain-form lines in practice-setup and the casual replies in e6 are intended voices (a sample file and a colleague). lint --strict finds no banned phrase or long sentence. Wording is left to ja-editor.
The jp locale is complete, including the Japanese diagram labels. s3-diagram's alt describes exactly what is drawn, and its caption is present. The link text says where it goes (「公式ドキュメント（日本語）」).

niceToHave: lesson.glossary セッション (changed): the entry says 「始まる」 and then 「始めるたびに…始まります」, three forms of the same verb in two sentences. For the second sentence, use the cc-05 wording: 「新しいセッションは、前の会話を持たずに始まります。」. It is the same length and matches cc-05-context exactly (ja-editor to confirm).

lesson.glossary セッション (changed) vs s2 (unchanged): the s2 block says 「途中で直した行は、`/clear`、`/compact`、再起動のあとに反映されます」, while the glossary now ties a session's start to launching `claude`. A learner may not see why `/clear` counts as a fresh start without a restart. The flashcard and s2 text are correct as they stand. A clause such as 「（`/clear` でも新しく始まります）」 in the glossary would close the gap, if cross-lesson-facts.md or the official docs confirm that `/clear` starts a new session (factual doubt: unverified here).

s1-table (unchanged): the caption says 「（広い順）」, but 「どこでも」 comes after 「組織全体」 and reads as broader. Replace the caption with 「CLAUDE.mdの4つの置き場所と届く範囲（読まれる順）」, or replace row 2 col 1 with 「自分全般」 (ja-editor to confirm).

check-quiz e6 option a (unchanged): replace md with 「「Claudeが自動メモリにも書いたから、もう確実だよ」」 and feedback with 「自動メモリもCLAUDE.mdと同じく、読まれる頼みごとです。止めたい操作は、拒否ルールやフックで決めておきます。」. This gives 自動メモリ (s1-defs) a use. Offset the added characters against the 2,400 cap.
check-quiz e2 option a (unchanged): 「IMPORTANT」 is still the wrong answer in 5 items. Replace e2 a md with 「CLAUDE.mdに「編集したら必ず整形する」と書く」 and keep its feedback.
s4-check q5 option c (unchanged): replace the answer md with 「CLAUDE.mdの行は、Claude Codeが操作を止める設定ではないから」, so the answer no longer restates s4-lead and cannot be picked by recognition alone.

objectives o1 (unchanged): e2 assesses choosing a hook, which o1 does not list. Change o1 text to 「指示の置き場所（CLAUDE.md・.claude/rules/・CLAUDE.local.md・権限ルール・フック）を、内容に合わせて選べる」. This forces a full review next round.
Budget guard: prose is 2399 of the 2,400 cap (measure.mjs). Offset any text a fix adds with an equal cut.
summary: Verification round: review-scope.mjs exited 0, and only lesson.glossary changed (2%). The previous full review had no must-fix items, so there are no resolved entries. The new セッション definition is correct, matches cc-01 and cc-05, and fits s1-lead better than 「1回分のやりとり」. prior and accuracy were re-scored at 4, and the mean stays 3.46. validate and lint --strict are clean, and measure.mjs gives prose 2399/2400 and est 19.3 min. Open suggestions are wording only: the repeated 「始まる」 in the new entry, and the earlier IMPORTANT-pattern and s1-table items.
